announcements.text: RTX Corp., Pratt & Whitney Military Engines, East Hartford, Connecticut, is awarded a not-to-exceed $240,754,035 cost-plus-incentive-fee and cost-plus-fixed-fee modification (P00013) to previously awarded contract (N0001924C0042). This modification increases the not-to-exceed value, adding scope to provide non-recurring engineering to mature the F135 engine, address operational issues, improve readiness, and support the transition of the engine core upgrade from risk reduction design review into engineering and manufacturing development, including long-lead hardware for a spare test engine in support of the Air Force, Marine Corps, Navy, and F-35 Cooperative Program Partners F-35 Joint Strike Fighter programs. Work will be performed in East Hartford, Connecticut (53%); Indianapolis, Indiana (15%); Middletown, Connecticut (7%); West Palm Beach, Florida (7%); Windsor Locks, Connecticut (6%); North Berwick, Maine (5%); Rockford, Illinois (4%); and Aguadilla, Puerto Rico (3%), and is expected to be completed in March 2028. Fiscal 2025 research, development, test and evaluation (Air Force) funds in the amount of $87,574,189; fiscal 2025 research, development, test and evaluation (Navy) funds in the amount of $87,574,190; and F-35 cooperative program partner funds in the amount of $39,008,976, will be obligated at the time of award. This contract was not competitively procured. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.
